description: For all finite lists \(s,t\), \(A(C(s),C(t))=C(s\mathbin{\smallfrown}t)\), including empty lists.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.append_code (s t : List ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.append
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code s)
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code t) =
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.code (s ++ t)
